name: Singapore 2026 qualifying
what: Measured track model: fused centreline, corner geometry and the real field's driving statistics from 21 qualifying laps
sources: Telemetry: OpenF1 (api.openf1.org/v1) via concept/data/telemetry/singapore (see its README for licence and method)
Corner markers: MultiViewer circuit API (api.multiviewer.app), as used by FastF1 get_circuit_info()
Official length: formula1.com circuit page (4927 m)

units.distance: m along the model centreline from the timing line
units.stats: {mean, std (sample, n-1), min, max, n} across drivers

geometry.frame: F1 timing frame (OpenF1 x/y / 10, metres), assumed right-handed
